Issue_Reported: The BR+0 Heparin, 3 ml Immunology tube, only drew ~2 ml.
Description_of_Action_Taken: No action was taken at the time of the blood collection or immediately thereafter. The shortage was not identified until processing. After the shortage was reported, 3 actions were taken: 1) analysis of cause, 2) assessment of what analyses could be performed, data rescue/science impact, and 3) assessment of preventive measures.
Disposition_Comments: This 3ml heparin vacuum tube did not draw the full amount. The shortage was not apparent to the nurse drawing the blood. The label was wrapped around the tube so the volume was not visible. It is possible that had the label been applied to the tube in such a way that the operator could see the level after drawing, the operator might have been able to detect a shortage. Data not recovered: Viral Peptide Stimulation. FAP will assist by preparing the tubes with labels and marking the tubes with a fill line.
